principles: Host-neutral validation must verify the current Lattice CLI surface, not legacy host implementation leftovers.
Configuration migration must be explicit and reversible: prefer lattice.config.json while preserving koala.config.json fallback.
Automatic fallback discovery should stay conservative and never surprise users with deprecated platform tests.
Gate evidence must be structured, reproducible, and tied to user-visible CLI output.
drivers: User has declared Swift/Mac Native App deprecated for current capability work.
Existing repositories may still rely on koala.config.json, so hard rename would break gates.
B-1691 dispatch runtime depends on Lattice CLI JSON smoke evidence, not Swift test evidence.

options.name: Remove Swift auto fallback and add lattice.config.json with koala legacy fallback
pros: Stops Package.swift from hijacking current validation gates
Supports canonical Lattice naming without breaking old repos
Allows explicit Swift opt-in for legacy projects
cons: Requires touching config loading, diagnostics, docs, and smoke tests together

options.name: Only add Koala repo validate.js and leave core fallback unchanged
pros: Fast local fix for Koala repo
cons: Other host-neutral repos with Package.swift remain exposed
Swift still appears as current standard fallback in core docs/diagnostics

options.name: Hard rename koala.config.json to lattice.config.json and remove legacy config immediately
cons: Breaks existing repos and managed assets
Forces unrelated migration into one validation story

chosen: Remove Swift auto fallback and add lattice.config.json with koala legacy fallback
rationale: This option fixes the stale validation root cause while making the Lattice config migration explicit and backward compatible; it preserves legacy Swift only as an opt-in configured command.

preMortem.scenario: Package.swift repos still run swift test after the change
preMortem.trigger: Swift removal only updates verifier.ts but runtime checks or docs still advertise swift fallback
preMortem.consequence: Future stories can still record stale Swift gate evidence and user trust remains broken
preMortem.mitigation: Add validation-protocol smoke with Package.swift-only temp repo and grep docs/diagnostics for current swift fallback guidance.

preMortem.scenario: Existing koala.config.json repos fail validation after config rename
preMortem.trigger: loadConfig only reads lattice.config.json and ignores legacy file
preMortem.consequence: Installed repos lose storyDir/validate config and lifecycle gates fail unexpectedly
preMortem.mitigation: Implement ordered config resolution: lattice.config.json canonical, koala.config.json legacy fallback, with smoke coverage for both.

preMortem.scenario: Both config files exist and users cannot tell which one won
preMortem.trigger: Config loader silently merges or picks one without diagnostics
preMortem.consequence: Validation commands appear inconsistent and debugging becomes opaque
preMortem.mitigation: Prefer lattice.config.json, expose config source/conflict warning in scan/doctor/validate setup, and test conflict diagnostics.

preMortem.scenario: Docs accidentally imply Swift/Mac Native is still the current product gate
preMortem.trigger: README/testing-infra/prompts retain old Swift automatic fallback language
preMortem.consequence: Agents keep running or citing Swift tests for Lattice CLI stories
preMortem.mitigation: Update current validation docs to lattice.config.json/validate.js/configured commands; keep Swift only in explicit legacy executor context.
